rows.name: autoRoute
rows.note: Whether the Chief may route each subagent to the harness best at its task (spawn(harness)), whatever harness the Chief itself runs on (Leo 2026-11-01: "maybe toggle off-able but if you look into grokbot they auto route stuff all the time"). Off by default (Leo 2026-11-01: "optional ofc we don't wanna change defaults or whatnot yet"); a Chief's own chief engine set --subagent-routing auto|off wins over it. Read at each spawn.

title.text: Route Subagents to the Best Agent

help.text: The Chief picks the agent each subagent runs on, such as Codex for long coding work and Claude for writing and UI, even when the Chief itself runs on another. Off, subagents run on the Chief's own agent.
